summary: Avis Budget Group filed an 8-K reporting that its Avis Budget Rental Car Funding (AESOP) LLC subsidiary closed a $650 million asset-backed note issuance on September 21, 2026. The five-year Series 2026-5 comprises $474.5 million 5.69% Class A, $61.75 million 5.95% Class B, $47.125 million 6.44% Class C, and $66.625 million 8.14% Class D notes, plus $35.75 million 9.598% Class R notes retained by AESOP Leasing L.P. for U.S. risk-retention compliance. Notes are secured by domestic fleet vehicles and related assets under the base indenture. This is routine fleet financing, not a special situation.
